items.claim: Trevin Giles is coming off a good win.
items.quote: Trevin Giles is coming off a good win.

items.claim: Don'Tae Johnson is a very big, powerful dude who used to fight at heavyweight.
items.quote: A very big dude, used to fight at heavyweight as well. I think he's like 5'8" and he used to fight at heavyweight. So, very big, powerful dude.

items.claim: Don'Tae Johnson has finished nearly everybody on the regional scene and is a good wrestler.
items.quote: Bit finished nearly everybody on the regional scene. Good wrestler.

items.claim: Eric McConico has good enough takedown defense and is a decent little striker.
items.quote: He's got a good enough takedown defense. He's a decent little striker.

items.claim: Jalin Turner half-retired last year and has been hellishly inactive.
items.quote: Jalin Turner, I mean, listen, he half-retired last year and he's been hellishly inactive

items.claim: Caio Fernandes battered Guram Kutateladze in their fight.
items.quote: Battered Guram Kutateladze when Guram had... I think he had Alexandre in his corner, as well. He battered Guram Kutateladze in that fight.

items.claim: Jalin Turner has awful fight IQ and is too inconsistent.
items.quote: His fight IQ is awful, as well. I'm going to go Caio Fernandes by decision... he's too inconsistent for my liking.

items.claim: Charles Johnson has only been knocked out at one point in his UFC career.
items.quote: Charles Johnson, he's only been knocked out in one point in his UFC career

items.claim: Jose Aldo has really slick boxing and his takedown defense holds up too.
items.quote: he's got really good boxing... and his takedown defense holds up too.
